items.quote: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
items.claim: The shepherds drove the women away from the water. Moses stood up, helped them and watered their flock.
items.action: stood up and helped them, and watered their flock
items.object: them (the women driven away by the shepherds) and their flock
items.mechanism: Moses stepped in when the shepherds drove the women away and watered their flock himself
